rules.rationale: Animation assets benefit from an asset capture and explicit functional states.
Architecture assets benefit from component isolation and open/closed or construction states.
Modular buildings need isolated modules and explicit connection or construction states.
Audio assets benefit from variant and playback-state tracking even when no image capture is required.
Character assets benefit from a complete subject capture, isolated components, and functional states.
Humanoid characters benefit from isolated body, garment, accessory, variant, and state references.
Creature assets benefit from complete subject, anatomical component, and state references.
Environment assets benefit from modular component and condition-state references.
Material assets benefit from palette variants and surface-condition states.
Generic assets need an explicit review of their component, variant, and state capture scope.
Props benefit from complete subject, isolated parts, and functional state references.
Handheld tools benefit from grip components, visual variants, and operational states.
Terrain assets benefit from modular pieces, palette variants, and terrain-condition states.
Texture assets benefit from material variants and usage-condition states.
UI assets benefit from visual variants and interaction states.
Vegetation assets benefit from modular parts, growth variants, and seasonal states.
Vehicles benefit from isolated parts, configuration variants, and operational states.
VFX assets benefit from variant and lifecycle-state references.
